d: More than 200 people paid up to $440,000 for a permanent home aboard a luxury cruise ship. Some even sold their houses to begin a new life at sea. But the MV Odyssey's voyage came to an abrupt halt when its operator, Villa Vie Residences, ran out of money and left passengers stranded in Cambodia. Some are now renting local apartments as they figure out their next move. The ship has since been seized in Singapore over unpaid fuel bills. From a floating retirement home to a Wi-Fi-connected juicer that people could operate with their bare hands, we look at bizarre business ideas, the people…
